crossRefs.note: The priest answered David, and said, “I have no common bread, but there is holy bread; if only the young men have kept…
I wish that this people were under my hand! Then I would remove Abimelech.” He said to Abimelech, “Increase your army…
Indeed a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying, “You have clothing, you be our ruler…

translations.web: Now therefore what is under your hand? Please give me five loaves of bread in my hand, or whatever is available.”
translations.bsb: Now then, what do you have on hand? Give me five loaves of bread, or whatever can be found.”
translations.kjv: Now therefore what is under thine hand? give me five loaves of bread in mine hand, or what there is present.
translations.asv: Now therefore what is under thy hand? give me five loaves of bread in my hand, or whatsoever there is present.
